title: Initiative rollup
description: Every initiative a record holds, with what it has delivered against what it promised, as `wipctl initiatives --json` emits it — the epics rollup one tier up. Derived on every call and stored nowhere. It names no members: the member epics are the decomposition's answer, described by initiative.schema.json.

initiatives.description: One entry per document under initiatives/, in id order. An initiative no epic has joined appears at zero rather than being omitted.

id.description: The title's slug, plus at most a qualifying postfix where that slug was taken. Shared across stories, epics, initiatives, and questions, so one id names one thing.

closed_points.description: Points delivered. The member epics' numbers summed; one implementation computes all three tiers, so a number cannot appear twice with two values.

total_points.description: Points promised across every member epic, a cut member included.

open.description: Members not yet closed, across every member epic.

closed_out.description: True when nothing remains open in any member epic. Deliberately not a claim that the initiative is done: closed out is not done, which is why the document carries Done when. Nothing derives a retirement decision from it.
